title: Living With Double Vision, An Artist’s Journey with Diplopia
original_title: Living With Double Vision, An Artist’s Journey with Diplopia
overview: In this eye-opening documentary on how she copes with a debilitating illness that affects her vision and therefore ability to work, Lili Giacobino, artist and stop-motion creator and producer, relates her journey of determination and resilience. Dedicated to the people who have continued to support her, this film pays it forward to other artists and crafters who may find themselves in a similar situation.
